description:
*Objective:* Verify that a signed-in user can add three copies of an in-stock book and the cart shows quantity 3 with the correct subtotal.

*Type:* positive  
*Level:* end-to-end  
*Priority:* high

*Preconditions:*
* Application is reachable (local disposable environment)
* A regular user account is available
* Books are located by title via catalog search, never by ID, because IDs change when the database is reseeded
* Book "1984" has stock >= 3; read the real price and stock at run time

*Test data:*
* Book: 1984
* Quantity: 3
* Expected subtotal: 3 x price read on the page ($41.97 at $13.99)

*Steps & Expected results:*
# Open the login page and sign in with the regular user account  
   *Expected:* User lands on the catalog page; the Logout button is visible
# Open the cart; remove every line that is present  
   *Expected:* Cart is empty; the cart badge in the navigation is absent or 0
# On the catalog page type "1984" into the search box and click Search  
   *Expected:* A catalog card titled "1984" is listed
# Open the detail page of "1984"  
   *Expected:* Detail page opens with heading "1984"
# Set the Quantity field to 3  
   *Expected:* Value is 3
# Click Add to Cart  
   *Expected:* Cart badge shows 3
# Open the cart  
   *Expected:* One line "1984" is listed
# Read the line quantity and subtotal  
   *Expected:* Quantity 3, subtotal $41.97

*Postconditions:*
* Cart contains one line "1984" with quantity 3 and subtotal $41.97
* Cart is emptied afterwards

*Traceability:*
* User story: REF-10
title: Add three copies of a book to cart
